determinism.result: Both clean fixed-epoch strict builds produced byte-identical PDFs after deterministic page-label normalization and exact rewriting of both HTML-relative lab annotations to the canonical public HTTPS target.

pre_admission_repair.failure: The first strict attempt exposed an undefined \Int control sequence at generated TeX line 3779 and was rejected before admission.
pre_admission_repair.repair: The cumulative reader wrapper now closes that inherited notation dependency with \newcommand{\Int}{\text{Int}}; this is a rendering-closure repair and does not change the translated mathematical content.
pre_admission_repair.verification: Both subsequent clean strict runs are error-free and byte-identical, and targeted inspection confirms readable Int(A) notation.

final_latex_run.package_warning_assessment: The final pass contains one obsolete xcolor option warning and two geometry over-specification warnings; none affects content or page containment.

page_label_gate.assessment: Embedded viewer labels agree with print; four top-level outline entries, eight chapter children, eight appendix children, the index, 200 annotations, two lab links and all pages survive normalization.

uri_link_gate.assessment: The PDF contains no filesystem-relative URI. Both annotations use the canonical public HTTPS location, whose exact target is present in the staged Pages tree; anonymous public-byte readback remains part of the publication transaction.

accessibility_and_extraction_gate.caveat: All 37 font resources are embedded and subset, but 15 lack ToUnicode maps. Poppler extracts 513,020 characters with no U+FFFD, NUL or literal cid tokens, while 84 non-pagebreak C0 controls remain in mathematical text. The newly added Chapter 8 surfaces affected are physical pages 73, 75, 80, 177 and 178.
accessibility_and_extraction_gate.disposition: This does not block visual/structural admission or preservation of the reader PDF, but the PDF must not be represented as tagged or fully text-accessible. The validated HTML reader remains the primary accessible surface.

findings.detail: Two Chapter 8 diagnostics and six inherited diagnostics remain visually contained and readable.
Fifteen of 37 embedded subset font resources lack ToUnicode maps, producing 84 non-pagebreak C0 controls in Poppler extraction; visual glyphs are intact, and HTML is the primary accessible surface.
The PDF has no structure tree or marked-content declaration; it must not be described as a tagged PDF.
A rejected pre-admission build exposed the missing Int macro; the reader wrapper now supplies it, and both final strict runs are error-free and byte-identical.
Both lab annotations use the canonical HTTPS Pages target; the staged target is present and anonymous public readback remains part of publication QA.

result_rationale: PASS: all 187 pages are visually clean; Chapter 8 and complete Appendix H support are readable; the final pass is error-, reference- and missing-glyph-free; labels, outlines and link counts are exact; both lab links are portable HTTPS targets; and both clean builds are byte-identical. The untagged PDF and incomplete ToUnicode coverage are explicitly retained as nonblocking accessibility/text-extraction caveats, with HTML designated as the primary accessible surface.
